코.x: My nose is stuffed up because of a cold.

더.forms: 더 + adjective/verb: 더 커요 · A보다 B가 더 …
더.x: My younger sibling is taller than me.

열이 나다.forms: 열이 나요 · 열이 났어요; 열이 많이 나다 (to have a high fever)
열이 나다.m: to have a fever, to run a temperature
열이 나다.ex: 아이가 밤새 열이 나서 병원에 갔어요.
열이 나다.x: My child had a fever all night, so we went to the hospital.

화.ex: 친구가 약속을 또 잊어버려서 화가 났어요.
화.x: My friend forgot our plans again, so I got angry.
화.e: Literally 'fire': anger as heat rising inside you.
화.t: It usually appears as 화가 나다 (to feel angry) or 화를 내다 (to show anger).

여자 친구.x: I gave my girlfriend flowers for her birthday.

암.ex: 담배를 피우면 암에 걸릴 위험이 높아져요.
암.x: Smoking raises your risk of getting cancer.
암.t: Diseases take 걸리다: 암에 걸리다, 감기에 걸리다.

귀걸이.x: I got pretty earrings as a birthday present.
귀걸이.e: 귀 'ear' + 걸이 'something hung,' from 걸다 'to hang.'

상식.x: Greeting your elders is basic common sense.
상식.e: Literally 'ordinary knowledge' — what everyone is expected to know.
상식.t: 상식이 없다 means someone lacks common sense — fairly harsh criticism.

신제품.ex: 그 회사는 다음 달에 신제품을 출시할 예정이에요.
신제품.x: That company plans to release a new product next month.

두근거리다.m: to pound, to throb, to flutter (of the heart)
두근거리다.x: My heart was pounding so hard before the presentation.
두근거리다.e: From 두근두근, the sound of a racing heart, plus -거리다 'keep doing'.
두근거리다.t: The subject is usually 가슴 or 심장: 가슴이 두근거려요 'My heart is racing.'

수하물.x: It took 30 minutes to get my baggage at the airport.
수하물.e: Literally 'hand-load things': a formal airport word.
수하물.t: Airport signs say 수하물 찾는 곳 'baggage claim'; in everyday speech people say 짐.

명확하다.x: Please answer the teacher's question clearly.

창의적.ex: 그 학생은 항상 창의적인 아이디어를 내요.
창의적.x: That student always comes up with creative ideas.

평균 수명.ex: 한국인의 평균 수명은 계속 늘어나고 있습니다.
평균 수명.x: Koreans' average life expectancy keeps rising.
평균 수명.e: Literally 'even and equal' plus 'span of life'.

멜로디.ex: 그 노래는 멜로디가 쉬워서 금방 따라 부를 수 있어요.
멜로디.x: That song has an easy melody, so you can sing along right away.

무더위.m: sweltering heat, hot and humid weather
무더위.x: This year the sweltering heat started early, in June.
무더위.e: Built like 무덥다 'to be hot and humid'; 더위 means 'heat'.

민주화.x: Korea achieved democratization in the 1980s through great effort.
민주화.t: 민주화 운동 usually refers to Korea's pro-democracy movement, such as Gwangju 1980 and June 1987.

병역.ex: 한국에서는 건강한 남성이라면 병역의 의무가 있습니다.
병역.x: In Korea, healthy men have a duty to do military service.
병역.t: Usually heard in set phrases like 병역의 의무 (duty of military service) and 병역 면제 (exemption).

저마다.forms: 저마다 + verb/noun: 저마다 다르다, 저마다의 이유
저마다.m: each, every one (in their own way)
저마다.ex: 사람들은 저마다 다른 꿈을 가지고 있어요.
저마다.x: Each person has a different dream.

꺼리다.m: to be reluctant, to avoid, to shy away from
꺼리다.ex: 그는 사람들 앞에서 말하는 것을 꺼려요.
꺼리다.x: He's reluctant to speak in front of people.
꺼리다.t: Usually -기를 꺼리다 or -는 것을 꺼리다: 대답하기를 꺼렸어요.

넘기다.m: to turn (a page); to hand over; to pass (a time, a deadline); to get through
넘기다.x: I read slowly, turning the pages.
넘기다.e: Causative of 넘다 'to go over': make something go over.

골치가 아프다.m: to be a headache, to be troublesome and hard to deal with
골치가 아프다.ex: 이사 준비 때문에 요즘 골치가 아파요.
골치가 아프다.x: Getting ready to move has been giving me a headache lately.
골치가 아프다.e: 골치 is a colloquial word for the head or brain (골 'brain'), so literally 'the head hurts'.
골치가 아프다.t: For annoying problems, not real headaches (use 머리가 아프다 for those): 골치 아픈 문제 'a thorny problem'. Related: 골칫거리 'a nuisance'.

방어적.x: When I pointed out his mistake, he became defensive.

한술 더 뜨다.forms: 한술 더 떠요 · 한술 더 떴어요 · 한술 더 떠서 (ㅡ drops)
한술 더 뜨다.m: to go one step further (usually worse); to go even further
한술 더 뜨다.ex: 형이 늦게 왔는데 동생은 한술 더 떠서 아예 안 왔어요.
한술 더 뜨다.x: My older brother came late, and my younger brother went one worse: he didn't show up at all.
한술 더 뜨다.e: Literally 'to scoop one more spoonful'; 술 here means a spoonful.
한술 더 뜨다.t: Usually negative: someone outdoes another in bad behavior.

공적.ex: 그는 나라를 위한 공적을 인정받아 상을 받았어요.
공적.x: He received an award in recognition of his service to the country.
공적.t: Homonym: 공적(公的) means 'public, official', as in 공적인 자리 'an official setting'.

부조리.x: He blew the whistle on the corrupt practices within the company.
부조리.e: Literally 'not in line with reason' — what doesn't add up or isn't fair.

이르다.forms: 이르러요 · 이르렀어요 · 이를 거예요 · 이르세요 (러 irregular)
이르다.m: to reach, arrive at; to lead to (a result)
이르다.ex: 긴 회의 끝에 두 회사는 결국 합의에 이르렀어요.
이르다.x: After a long meeting, the two companies finally reached an agreement.
이르다.t: This 'reach' sense is 러 irregular (이르러요), unlike 이르다 'to be early/to tell' (일러요).

데뷔조.m: debut team, group of trainees set to debut
데뷔조.x: I finally got the call saying I'd been picked for the debut team.
데뷔조.t: Being in the 데뷔조 doesn't guarantee a debut; the lineup can still change before the group launches.

읽씹.m: leaving a message on read (without replying)
읽씹.x: I sent a message, but my friend left me on read.
읽씹.e: 읽(고) 씹다 'read and ignore'; 씹다 'to chew' is slang for ignoring someone.
읽씹.t: Casual. Pronounced [익씹]. 읽씹하다 = to leave on read; 안읽씹 = ignoring without even reading.

온열 질환.ex: 폭염에는 온열 질환에 걸리지 않게 물을 자주 드세요.
온열 질환.x: During a heat wave, drink water often so you don't get heat-related illness.
온열 질환.t: Pronounced [오녈 질환]. The official term in heat warnings; specific types include 열사병 'heatstroke' and 일사병 'sunstroke, heat exhaustion'.

정상외교.ex: 대통령은 이번 순방에서 활발한 정상외교를 펼쳤어요.
정상외교.x: The president engaged in active summit diplomacy on this tour.
정상외교.t: Homonym alert: 정상 (頂上) = summit/leader, while 정상 (正常) = normal.

통상.ex: 정부는 통상 문제를 논의하기 위해 대표단을 보냈습니다.
통상.x: The government sent a delegation to discuss trade issues.
통상.t: Don't confuse with the homonym 통상 'usually' (通常), as in 통상 9시에 시작해요.
rel: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

일원론.ex: 일원론은 세계가 하나의 근본 원리로 이루어졌다고 봐요.
일원론.x: Monism holds that the world is made of a single fundamental principle.

창극.m: changgeuk, Korean traditional opera based on pansori
창극.x: The pansori 'Chunhyangga' was made into a changgeuk and staged.
창극.e: Literally 'sung drama': pansori split among many singers in costume.

사대부.ex: 사대부들은 유교 경전을 공부하고 관직에 나갔어요.
사대부.x: The literati studied the Confucian classics and entered government office.

성행하다.m: to be prevalent, to be rampant, to flourish
성행하다.x: Online scams are rampant these days.

미디어리터러시.ex: 학교에서 미디어리터러시 교육이 점점 중요해지고 있어요.
미디어리터러시.x: Media literacy education is becoming more and more important in schools.
미디어리터러시.e: From English 'media literacy'; also called 미디어 문해력.

작용하다.m: to act on, to work, to have an effect, to play a role
작용하다.ex: 이번 결정에는 여러 요인이 복합적으로 작용했습니다.
작용하다.x: Several factors worked together in this decision.
작용하다.e: Literally 'make use' — a force or factor having an effect.

갈무리하다.m: to store away, to put away neatly; to wrap up, to finish off (work)
갈무리하다.x: Grandma stored away the harvested grain in the storehouse.
갈무리하다.e: From 갈무리 'putting things away in order' — now also 'wrapping up' a project or text.

벼리다.m: to sharpen (a blade by heating and hammering); to hone, to steel (one's resolve)
벼리다.ex: 대장장이가 무딘 칼을 불에 달궈 다시 벼렸어요.
벼리다.x: The blacksmith heated the dull knife and sharpened it again.
벼리다.e: A blacksmith's word: reforging a blade with fire and hammer, unlike 갈다 (grinding on stone).

무상증자.x: The stock price rose sharply on news of a bonus issue.
무상증자.e: Literally 'unpaid capital increase': shareholders get new shares for free.
무상증자.t: 유상 (paid) and 무상 (free) are an everyday pair: 무상 교육 means free education.
